component.name: Faugus
component.summary: A simple and lightweight app for running games using UMU-Launcher

ul.li: Play Windows games using Proton
Play Linux native games
Run Windows games directly from the .exe file
Prefix management
Shortcut and Steam shortcut management
Winetricks: A helper tool to easily install dependencies, fonts, DLLs, and tweaks for Wine.
Winecfg: Wine's graphical interface to configure Windows versions, libraries, drivers, and integrations.
MangoHud: Shows an overlay for monitoring FPS, temperatures, CPU/GPU load and more.
Feral GameMode: Tweaks your system to improve performance.
Prefer SDL: May fix controller issues in some games.
Additional Application: An additional application to run with the game, like Cheat Engine, Trainers, Mods...
Lossless Scaling Frame Generation: Create fake frames to increase the framerate.
Proton Manager: Download/Remove popular Proton builds.
Wine Wayland Driver support (Experimental).
HDR Support (Experimental).
Gamescope doesn't work.
New backup system. Now it can back up specific games, their prefixes, and shortcuts. It can also back up Protons.
Added an overview panel with the game name, playtime, and last played time for Grid, Covers, and Carousel modes.
Added an option to select the color of the overview.
Now it records the last time played.
Added an option to position the Grid, Covers, and Carousel.
Added an option to change the orientation of Grid and Covers.
Added an option to set the maximum number of rows/columns for Grid and Covers.
Added tabs to the Settings window, as there are now many interface customization options.

Removed the logging option from the Settings window. Apparently, even after being warned, users keep it enabled and experience performance issues. Now there's an option in the game's menu to launch it with logging enabled.
Now extracts the icon from the executable after running an installer.
Fixed hidden games having the wrong size.
Fixed the path not being remembered in the Path file chooser.
Fixed the banner not being updated on the main screen after changing it.
Fixed banners being duplicated.
Fixed the app not manually starting minimized to the tray.
Fixed a game mismatch in Carousel when sorted by last played.
Updated translations.
